Carapace Armor is a Mistlands-tier armor. This set is the tier above Padded Armor and is replaced by Flametal Armor, the Ask Set, and the Embla Set.

Armor pieces

[edit | edit source]

This set of armor has three pieces which are crafted and upgraded at the Black Forge.

Beyond their normal maximum quality, these items can be upgraded further at the Forge of Potential with a Black Marble Protection Idol.
